newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber ends higher on technical rally.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber ends higher on technical rally.

text.p: CME lumber futures closed with strong gains after technical buying developed near midday when contracts were slightly lower, traders said.
As gains increased so did the buying momentum led by Smith Barney buying September contracts.
On the way up chart-based buy orders were activated to extend gains, they said.
Fundamentally, the Commerce Department's May home sales report, released before the opening, was considered bullish but had failed to inspire early buying, traders said.
"Those were fairly impressive numbers," said one analyst of the 7.1 percent gain in May home sales.
CME lumber closed up $6.70 to $1.00 with July up the most at $378.00 and September up $6.30 at $371.30.
